perField.vocabAnswer: A random process is one where all outcomes are known, but individual results are UNPREDICTABLE.
perField.termType: OUTCOME = result of ONE trial. EVENT = a COLLECTION of outcomes (can be multiple results grouped together).
perField.independenceAnswer: In independent events, past results do NOT affect future probabilities. Each trial has the same probability regardless of what happened before.
perField.streakAnswer: Humans tend to think streaks are unusual, but in truly random data, streaks of 5, 6, 7, or even 8+ are actually quite COMMON.
perField.simVocabAnswer: Simulation = model random events so that simulated outcomes closely match REAL-WORLD outcomes.
perField.llnAnswer: Law of Large Numbers: As trials INCREASE, simulated probability gets CLOSER to the TRUE probability.
perField.digitLow: Match the probability! If success is 82%, use digits 1-82 for success (82 out of 100).
perField.digitHigh: The upper bound should match the probability. For 25%, use 1-25 (25 out of 100).
perField.trialAnswer: One trial = simulating the ENTIRE scenario once. For free throws until miss: generate numbers until failure.
perField.designDigits: Match digits to the real probability. For 60% success: 1-60 = success, 61-100 = failure.
perField.designTrial: Describe what happens in ONE complete simulation and what you COUNT or RECORD.
perField.capConcept: Think about which concept (independence, LLN, simulation, random process) best explains the scenario.
perField.capExplain: Use key vocabulary: random process, independent, Law of Large Numbers, simulation, empirical probability.
perField.sampleSpaceAnswer: List ALL possible outcomes. For coins: {HH, HT, TH, TT}. For dice: {1,2,3,4,5,6}. Order matters when sequence is recorded!
perField.validProbChoice: Two conditions: (1) Each probability between 0 and 1, (2) All probabilities sum to exactly 1.
perField.validProbReason: Check BOTH: Are all probabilities 0-1? Do they add to 1? If either fails, it's invalid.
perField.complementAnswer: Complement rule: P(not A) = 1 - P(A). The event and its complement must sum to 1.
perField.atLeastOneAnswer: Use the complement! P(at least 1) = 1 - P(none). It's easier than adding all the ways to get 1, 2, 3...
perField.mixedAnswer: Apply the appropriate rule: sample space, complement (1-P), or P(at least 1) = 1 - P(none).
perField.mixedExplain: Mention the specific probability rule you used and show your calculation.
perField.meDefAnswer: Mutually exclusive = CANNOT occur at same time. P(A ∩ B) = 0. Also called 'disjoint'.
perField.jointProbAnswer: Joint probability: P(A ∩ B) = (count in both) / (GRAND total). Use the total of all observations!
perField.identifyMEAnswer: If P(A ∩ B) = 0 exactly, they ARE mutually exclusive. Any value > 0 means NOT mutually exclusive.
perField.condDefAnswer: P(B|A) = probability of B GIVEN A. Formula: P(A ∩ B) / P(A). The | means 'given'.
perField.condTableAnswer: For P(B|A): numerator = count in both A and B, denominator = total for A (the condition). NOT grand total!
perField.multRuleAnswer: Multiplication rule: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B|A). Multiply the first probability by the conditional probability.
perField.orderAgivenB: P(B|A) = (count in both) / (total for A). Different from P(A|B) which divides by total for B!
perField.orderBgivenA: P(A|B) = (count in both) / (total for B). Same numerator as P(B|A), but different denominator!
perField.capstone44Answer: Review: ME means P(A∩B)=0, Joint uses grand total, Conditional uses row/column total, Order matters in P(A|B).
perField.capstone44Explain: Explain which concept (mutually exclusive, joint probability, conditional, multiplication rule) applies and why.
perField.indepDefAnswer: Independent events: knowing one occurred doesn't change the other's probability. P(A|B) = P(A) or P(A∩B) = P(A)×P(B).
perField.checkIndepCondAnswer: Check if P(A|B) = P(A). If knowing B doesn't change A's probability, they are independent.
perField.pAB_calc: Multiply P(A) × P(B). If this equals P(A ∩ B), the events are independent.
perField.checkIndepMultAnswer: Compare P(A) × P(B) with P(A ∩ B). If they're equal, events are independent. If not, they're dependent.
perField.multIndepAnswer: For INDEPENDENT events only: P(A and B) = P(A) × P(B). Just multiply the individual probabilities!
perField.addRuleDefAnswer: Addition Rule: P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B). Subtract the intersection to avoid double counting!
perField.unionAnswer: Use: P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A ∩ B). For mutually exclusive events, P(A ∩ B) = 0, so just add!
perField.indepVsMeAnswer: Independent: P(A∩B) = P(A)×P(B), can occur together. Mutually exclusive: P(A∩B) = 0, CANNOT occur together. These are DIFFERENT concepts!
perField.capstone46Answer: Review: Independent means P(A|B)=P(A). Addition rule subtracts intersection. Independent events CAN occur together!
perField.capstone46Explain: Explain using independence criteria or addition rule formula. Distinguish independent from mutually exclusive!
perField.rvDefAnswer: Random variables are NUMERICAL outcomes of random behavior. Always use capital letters (X, Y, W) and define what is being measured.
perField.discContAnswer: DISCRETE = countable values with gaps (counts like 0,1,2,3). CONTINUOUS = infinite values in an interval (measurements like time, length).
perField.validDistAnswer: Check TWO things: (1) Each P(X) is between 0 and 1, (2) All probabilities sum to exactly 1.
perField.probDistAnswer: ADD the probabilities for all X values in the specified range. P(X ≤ 3) = P(0) + P(1) + P(2) + P(3).
perField.shapeAnswer: Look at where probability is concentrated. Right-skewed = tail extends right. Left-skewed = tail extends left. Uniform = all equal.
perField.meanAnswer: μ = Σ[x·P(x)]. Multiply EACH x value by its probability, then add ALL products together.
perField.stdDevAnswer: σ = √[Σ(x-μ)²·P(x)]. Find deviations from mean, square them, multiply by P(x), sum, then square root.
perField.interpretAnswer: Mean = long-run average. Standard deviation = typical variation from mean. Always include context and units!
perField.transformMeanAnswer: For Y = a + bX: multiply the mean by b, then add a. μY = a + b·μX
perField.transformSDAnswer: For Y = a + bX: multiply SD by |b| only. The constant 'a' shifts the center but doesn't change spread. σY = |b|·σX
perField.sumMeansAnswer: Means combine normally: μ(X+Y) = μX + μY. Just add the two means!
perField.diffMeansAnswer: Means combine normally: μ(X-Y) = μX - μY. Just subtract the two means!
perField.combinedSDSumAnswer: ⚠️ THE VARIANCE TRAP: Don't add SDs directly! Add VARIANCES first, then take the square root. σ(X+Y) = √(σX² + σY²)
perField.combinedSDDiffAnswer: ⚠️ TRAP PART 2: Even for X-Y, variances ADD! Subtracting uncertain things creates MORE uncertainty. σ(X-Y) = √(σX² + σY²)
perField.identifyErrorAnswer: Look for the classic mistakes: adding SDs directly, or subtracting variances for a difference.
perField.capstoneMeanAnswer: Calculate the combined mean first. Remember: means add/subtract normally.
perField.capstoneSDAnswer: For the SD: add the VARIANCES (σ²), then take the square root. Don't fall for the trap!
perField.binsCondition: BINS = Binary outcomes, Independent trials, Number of trials fixed, Same probability each trial.
perField.binomYesNo: Check all four BINS conditions to decide if it's binomial.
perField.binsExplain: Mention which BINS condition fails or confirm all four are satisfied.
perField.binomP: p = probability of success on each trial (constant).
perField.binomX: x = number of successes of interest.
perField.binomCumulativeProb: Sum binomial probabilities, or use the complement for "at least".
perField.binomCapstoneConcept: Decide if it's BINS, components, single probability, or cumulative probability.
perField.binomCapstoneExplain: Use binomial vocabulary and show the formula you used.
perField.binomParamsInterpret: Mean = long-run average successes; SD = typical variation.
perField.surprisedChoice: Unusual if the outcome is outside μ ± 2σ.
perField.surprisedExplain: Compute μ ± 2σ and compare the outcome.
perField.geomIdentify: Geometric = trials until first success. Binomial = fixed number of trials.
perField.capstone1012Concept: Identify binomial vs geometric and whether you need probability or parameters.
perField.capstone1012Value: Use the correct formula; remember geometric uses x-1.
perField.capstone1012Explain: State the distribution and formula used, and justify why it fits.
